invariants.evidence: Restricted soil temperature is composed into the existing serialized reference kernel/runtime path; no separate SWAP kernel or use-case-specific model version is introduced.
No file parsing, paths, formats or file-unit logic is added to kernel/process/runtime source; restart continues through typed runtime state contracts.
Thermal parameters, forcing, persistent thermal state, numerical configuration, workspace and result/diagnostics remain distinct types/categories.
Thermal persistent state is optional and allocated only for thermal-active profiles; inactive-column no-thermal-state test passes.
soil_temperature_workspace_t is owned by the backend model/worker path and is not embedded in persistent physical state or immutable parameters.
The logical runtime API remains compatible with template/state registries. F-MR39 qualifies serialized MultiSWAP composition only and makes no parallel layout/performance claim.
Richards and thermal trial execute inside the same kernel transaction. A forced thermal failure after a successful Richards solve leaves committed revision, time, water and temperature unchanged.
Rejected thermal trial followed by corrected forcing reproduces a fresh run from the same committed origin exactly.
Qualification uses arbitrary numeric t0, tm and t1 and introduces no day, month, year or midnight condition.
F-MR39 adds no coupling-window assumption. Generic interval semantics are preserved; coupling-window qualification remains owned by coupling workunits.
The existing transaction/retry state model used by coupling is not changed. F-MR39 does not itself qualify a groundwater coupler.
No groundwater interface contract, head residual or exchange-flux convention is changed by F-MR39.
Water storage and mass accounting explicitly exclude thermal energy. Existing F-MR19 water/restart path passes at O0 and O2 and active thermal runs satisfy the hard water-mass gate.
No soil-water interface-sensitivity API or tangent path is changed.
No additional full SWAP coupling runs or predictor/corrector production path is introduced.
Mixed active/inactive serialized MultiSWAP columns are isolated and reproduce separate reference runs. Parallel throughput remains a nonclaim.
No MODFLOW-cell-to-tile relation or surface-fraction logic is introduced into SWAP.
No deep-vadose component or interpretation of bottom flux as deep recharge is added.
No deep-vadose/direct-coupling transition or external storage transfer is changed.
Thermal runtime consumes the common soil-water solve result and semantic hydraulic view; it is not tied to a new Richards implementation.
The already qualified restricted soil-temperature process module is reused unchanged and replayed at exact F-VQ58 authority.
Thermal composition uses process_hydraulic_view_t via build_process_hydraulic_view and does not import HeadCalc internals.
soil_temperature_active is physical configuration; existing transaction/numerical policy remains separate. No performance policy silently changes thermal physics.
F-MR39 introduces no fallback ladder, relaxed physics or unbounded retry policy. Runtime-cost qualification is explicitly deferred.
Exact F-VQ58 scientific authority is replayed, preserving the full restricted reference qualification against which runtime composition is checked.
Backend observation records thermal activation, execution status and energy diagnostics internally. F-MR39 does not claim a broader external diagnostics publication API.
Inactive profiles allocate no thermal persistent state; thermal workspace is backend/worker-local. Optional functionality therefore does not impose per-column thermal state on inactive columns.

Thermal runtime composition is organized by template optional-state layout and runtime/backend ownership. No tile fractions, MODFLOW topology or transfer-zone relationships are moved into the SWAP kernel.
The implementation makes no midnight, one-day, .swp-input or direct-MODFLOW assumption; arbitrary interval tests pass.
This file provides the explicit 30-invariant assessment. The exact-candidate gate also emitted FMR39_ALL_30_ARCHITECTURE_INVARIANTS_AUDITED_BY_EVIDENCE=PASS.
